name: Don Coryell
role2026: Pro Football Hall of Fame Patriarch
team: San Diego Chargers (1978-1986) / St. Louis Cardinals
philosophy: Father of the modern vertical passing game: one-back sets, full route trees for every receiver, deep shots downfield off a power run game, and quarterback progressions that attacked every level of the field.
notableAchievements: Air Coryell Ancestor of Modern Passing Trees
